limitations: Small author-labeled diagnostic catalog, not an independent real-world test dataset.
Negation filtering is a bounded lexical heuristic, not language understanding; quoted threats can still cause false flags.
English training has no established Hindi/Hinglish generalization.
No model or threshold is selected using these diagnostic outcomes.
Uncertain and suspicious labels both remain advisory; neither bypasses human owner/quorum review.
